question: Is there an agreed fixed library for this notebook's timing runs? The only data I was given is the develop checkout: demo-data/images holds about 1,500 real pictures (png/webp/jpg, 9.9 GB, mostly large PNGs) with zero byte-identical duplicates, plus test-data/images (331). Unless told otherwise I will build the 2,000- and 8,000-picture libraries in my scratch space from those originals plus generated duplicates of known kinds (exact copies, re-encodes, resizes, small crops), so the reference groups are known by construction. Also: the GPU has only 0.3 GiB free for me, so I plan to run the full PixlStash task pipeline on CPU and report absolute times as CPU times; is that acceptable, or should I wait for GPU memory?
answer: Synthetic duplicates from demo data (Build the 2,000- and 8,000-picture libraries from demo-data and test-data plus generated exact copies, re-encodes, resizes and crops, so the reference groups are known by construction.); Wait for GPU memory (Hold the run until enough GPU memory is free for CLIP, so the stage timings match what a normal install sees.)
